description:
Tell Bing, Yandex, Naver and Seznam (IndexNow) that pages on a workspace site changed so they re-crawl sooner (not a guarantee of indexing). Google doesn't use IndexNow; Bing's index feeds ChatGPT search and Copilot.

Billing: free. At most 30 calls per hour per org that reach the key-file check.

When to call: after changed pages go live on a site that isn't a paired WordPress site (the plugin pings IndexNow itself). Submit only changed URLs: IndexNow throttles hosts that resubmit unchanged ones.

Key file: IndexNow needs https://<host>/<key>.txt served; if it isn't, nothing is submitted and status is "key_file_missing" with the filename and contents to publish, then call again.

Returns: { status: "submitted" | "not_accepted", site_id, host, key_location, submitted_urls, rejected: [{ input, reason }], duplicates_removed, batches: [{ host, url_count, http_status, ok, meaning }] } (200/202 accepted; 403 key file missing or wrong; 422 URLs don't match the host; 429 slow down) | { status: "key_file_missing", key_file: { url, filename, contents }, how_to_fix, wordpress? } | { status: "no_valid_urls", rejected }.

domain.description: The site's domain as added to AuditAE, e.g. "acme.com". Or pass site_id.

key_location.description: URL of an IndexNow key file the site already serves (Rank Math's, or the AuditAE plugin's under Settings → AuditAE → AI Crawlers), e.g. https://example.com/<key>.txt. Omit to use AuditAE's key for this site.

site_id.description: AuditAE site id from list_sites. Or pass domain.

urls.description: 1–100 changed paths ("/pricing") or absolute URLs on the site's domain or its www variant. Duplicates and #fragments are dropped, other hosts rejected.

name: submit_urls
title: Tell Bing and other IndexNow engines that pages changed
